newsitem.title: USA: Data Dimensions to buy Millennium U.K.
newsitem.headline: Data Dimensions to buy Millennium U.K.

text.p: Data Dimensions Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to buy Millennium U.K. Ltd. for an undisclosed amount.

Anticipated terms of the transaction are an initial payment of cash and stock, the company said. Data Dimensions spokeswoman Villette Nolon said if all criteria are met, Data would buy Millennium shares over two years in a procedure called an "earnout."
Les Thomas, a principal of Millennium U.K., would continue as managing director of the new subsidiary.

The move establishes Data Dimensions' first presence outside the United States, the company said, adding that it will create an international subsidiary, Data Dimensions U.K. PLC, to serve the U.K. market.

Data Dimensions provides knowledge-based and tools-assisted consulting and licensing services to companies involved in insurance, health care, telecommunications, manufacturing, financial services and public utilities.
Millennium U.K. has been a Data Dimensions licensee since 1994.
